settings.editor:
Hi, thanks for dropping by to check out Dance Reaction. I know that planning a party or a celebration, be it a wedding, corporate dinner, birthday or any other type of event, can take some time, and trying to find the right DJ for your event may be frustrating.

So what you will get here, is an uncomplicated honest look at what Dance Reaction is about, what I do, and how I make it work for your event.
When you are booking a dj for your function, the first thing you should be thinking about is what is important to the success of your function...

settings.html: ▶

settings.title: Price should be the last thing.

settings.editor: In reality, the cost of your entertainment is a small portion of your overall event budget - however, it WILL be the critical element of a successful event.

image.alt: Couple's first dance at a wedding reception

settings.editor: Through planning and communication, I will provide you with quality music and a great atmosphere designed specifically for your event. I have the experience and attention to detail to maximise the event's success!

You will find me well presented and professional at all times, whether DJing a private party or larger corporate events, all are treated with the same level of attention to detail, ensuring your event's complete success!

settings.title: Be sure to contact me to discuss your events requirements in detail!
